source: independent agent design after randomized scene selection; not requester definitions, active spans, semantic assertions, or automatic profile render gates
aggregation: all gates must PASS; FAIL and UNOBSERVABLE both prevent PASS; no rounding or partial credit
native_pixel_rule: Judge saved original generated pixels; no enhancement, synthetic magnification, prompt/audit substitution, or inference from candidate labels. Record native image path, SHA-256 and dimensions at review.

gates.expected: One clearly adult designed subject with reference-guided short dark jaw-length bob, separated wispy fringe and recognizable visible eye/nose/mouth contour relationships.
gates.confusion: Hair alone or a generic different face is partial; appearance does not establish real identity or original age.
gates.unobservable: Face too small, obscured or blurred to compare contours.

gates.expected: Open signal cabinet, handheld meter-to-cabinet test cable, clipped log card and pencil visibly support the cable-test-recording pause.
gates.confusion: Decorative wire, unconnected meter or clipboard alone is partial.
gates.unobservable: Handheld tools or cable endpoints cannot be distinguished.

gates.expected: The woman's left knee visibly loads a dark pad directly on the level concrete.
gates.confusion: Squat, floating knee, hidden pad or two knees raised is failure.
gates.unobservable: Knee/pad/ground interface is obscured or lost in fabric.

gates.expected: Actor-right boot sole is planted flat forward with a nearly upright right shin.
gates.confusion: Only toe touch, heel lift, crossed or folded front leg is failure.
gates.unobservable: Foot edge, sole plane or shin chain cannot be resolved.

gates.expected: Actor-left lower leg extends rearward to a distinct boot forefoot touching concrete while heel is raised.
gates.confusion: An entire rear sole flat, a floating boot, an extra unattached shoe or foot hidden by thigh is not enough.
gates.unobservable: Rear forefoot contact or heel elevation cannot be seen.

gates.expected: Hip placement is visually between left knee and right forward foot; torso inclines slightly forward and both legs connect plausibly to this one body.
gates.confusion: Sitting on heel, detached leg, impossible chain or hip outside the support base is failure.
gates.unobservable: Joint continuity or hip projection is concealed. Pixel judgment is visible plausibility rather than measured force balance.

gates.expected: Nose points slightly image-right; wider camera-facing image-left cheek is brighter than narrower image-right cheek.
gates.confusion: Bright background, generic side-light, inverse short-lighting or merely a bright nose is partial.
gates.unobservable: Face orientation or relative cheek brightness cannot be judged.

gates.expected: Small oval nose-shadow lies on darker image-right cheek with a visible lit gap separating it from the cheek shadow.
gates.confusion: Connected Rembrandt triangle, butterfly shadow beneath nose, split half-face or diffuse undifferentiated darkening fails this target.
gates.unobservable: Nose-shadow edge or the separating gap is absent from discernible native detail.

gates.expected: One small crisp lamp reflection is visible in each of the two visible eyes.
gates.confusion: An eye-white highlight, whole glowing iris, large soft bloom or a reflection in only one eye is partial.
gates.unobservable: Either eye lacks enough native pixels for a distinct reflection.

gates.expected: Relaxed upper eyelids with softly parted lips coexist with lens-directed eyes.
gates.confusion: Closed eyes, a broad tooth smile, tightly closed mouth or sideways attention does not satisfy the combined form.
gates.unobservable: Lid or lip aperture cannot be resolved.

gates.expected: A single full-body frame includes head, hands, both knees and both boots and preserves readable facial light and every ground-contact plane.
gates.confusion: A montage, face close-up cutting feet, feet view losing facial detail or cropped support point is failure.
gates.unobservable: Required small forms remain unreadable even though broad framing is correct.
